EC1: - Patients who are anticipated to require continued broad spectrum antibiotics [AND] with meropenem [OR] or pip-tazo IV for > 96 hours post-engraftment such as for known, documented infections necessitating prolonged treatment
EC2: - Patients with a prior documented infection with mycormycetes
EC3: - Patients who are greater than 2 days from time of neutrophil engraftment post AHCT
EC5: - Patients with acute GVHD >= grade II
EC6: - Patients unwilling [OR] or [NOT] unable to undergo the FMT via retention enema procedure
EC7: - Patients who have received treatment with an investigational agent within 2 weeks of enrollment
EC8: - Patients [NOT] unable to tolerate oral decontamination regimen of pip-tazo [OR] and nystatin due to prior allergy [OR] or intolerance of these medications
EC9: - Patients with any medical [OR] or psychological condition that, in the opinion of the investigator, might interfere with the subject's participation in the trial, pose any additional risk for the subject, [OR] or confound the assessments of the subject
